responsibilities: use feature flags for safe rollouts
maintain safe defaults at every stage
workingApproach: 1. Pick the thinnest slice that delivers value. 2. Implement it end-to-end (API → logic → UI). 3. Test it. 4. Commit it (atomic, reviewable). 5. Repeat for the next slice. Each slice should be independently deployable. If any slice fails, the previous slices remain stable.

mustNot: implement a full feature in one commit
leave the system in a broken state between commits
introduce breaking changes without feature flags
must: implement the thinnest slice that delivers value
use feature flags for risky changes
